Reference files for MentalScape 2.0, collected automatically by the `Ingest reference files` workflow from the addresses listed under `reference_files` in `config/sources.yaml`.

Files are stored exactly as downloaded, and CSV files are gzipped. Asset names follow the pattern `reference__id__edition__published__r1__checksum`. `manifest.csv` lists every asset with its source URL, checksums and download date.

Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

- English Indices of Deprivation 2025, Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government, https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/english-indices-of-deprivation-2025
- Lower layer Super Output Area population estimates, Office for National Statistics
- Geography lookups from the ONS Open Geography Portal. Source Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Contains OS data, Crown copyright and database right 2026.
